changes.description: 新发现仓库iAmCorey/kooky：面向AI coding的极简终端，主打sidebar workspace与live workspace state展示
changes.evidence: 「A minimal modern terminal for AI coding experience — Sidebar workspaces; horizontal / vertical split panes; one-click agent launch; per-agent activity readout; live workspace state with one-click Node and branch switching.」
changes.meee2_relevance: 推断：'live workspace state'和'per-agent activity readout'的措辞与meee2的live link/descriptive canvas理念在语言层面接近，但仍是单终端内的多pane实时状态展示，未见跨工具/跨owner的artifact pull，也未提人机同构session协议，结构重叠证据有限但值得持续观察

changes.description: 新发现仓库handmux/handmux：基于tmux的移动端vibe-coding驾驶舱，可从手机远程驱动本地终端里的live session
changes.evidence: 「A mobile vibe-coding cockpit — built on tmux: drive your live session, Claude Code / Codex — anything a terminal can run — from your phone.」
changes.meee2_relevance: 推断：'从手机驱动live session'与meee2 peripheral层(不切焦点、随时可达任意session)在'脱离主机也能触达session'这一目标上方向性重叠，但实现路径是手机+tmux而非菜单栏+5字戳，原文也未提人机同协议或跨工具artifact live link

changes.description: 新发现仓库shareAI-lab/learn-claude-code：从零实现Claude Code类agent harness的教学项目，近期(7/28)有代码推送
changes.evidence: 「Bash is all you need - A nano claude code–like 「agent harness」, built from 0 to 1」

changes.description: 新发现仓库luojiahai/code-by-wire：提供单一cockpit界面pilot多个coding agent并监控其telemetry
changes.evidence: 「Pilot coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and monitor their telemetry from one cockpit.」

changes.description: 新发现仓库trevormil/TerMinal：本地优先的coding agent软件工厂，含live cockpit、自主构建循环与跨仓库可观测性
changes.evidence: 「hosts the real Claude Code / Codex CLI with a live cockpit, autonomous build loop, scheduling, and cross-repo observability.」

changes.description: 新发现仓库bb4407777/areco：提供浏览器/手机端远程驾驶CLI coding agent的能力
changes.evidence: 「Remote cockpit for CLI coding agents — drive Claude Code / Codex / Reasonix from your browser or phone.」
